strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN with UDP/datagram-like earliest-complete inner delivery over WBD-owned TCP-shaped FakeTCP, a conservative release operating point on a physical link at or below 100 Mbit/s, shared username/password admission for multiple independent LiveID sessions, OpenWrt TPROXY capture, and Windows TUN/Wintun-class capture.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: Shared-account two-session clean-path fan-out and the 40 Mbit/s aggregate weak-link operating point are qualified. The coarse 60/80 Mbit/s ceiling diagnostic found a persistent tail-latency cliff, so do not retune transport; obtain one clean corrected sweep and only a narrow midpoint if more than 40 Mbit/s is worth pursuing, then freeze the protocol and move to final OpenWrt/Windows end-to-end integration.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Prioritize first-complete inner datagram delivery and balanced independent sessions. Never gate available systematic data on cumulative TCP repair, do not add multi-tenant identity complexity, do not change legacy FakeTCP recovery or fixed 20:20 during load-ceiling measurement, and reject extra throughput if it requires hundreds of milliseconds of persistent queueing.

udp_like_status.outer_semantics: WBD-owned TCP-shaped raw carrier with legacy shadow recovery as the product default. SACK/RACK remains explicit experimental research. Complete inner datagram delivery never waits for cumulative TCP ACK or repair.
udp_like_status.fec_status: Live negotiation admits FEC off or fixed systematic 20:20 tail-RS. Surviving systematic sources stream immediately and missing originals reconstruct from repair shards; no runtime config epoch or adaptive retune is qualified.
udp_like_status.two_client_clean_gate: GitHub Actions fullstack-mux-two-client run 32911866748 SUCCESS for both FEC off and fixed 20:20: two distinct tickets from one shared account, one public FakeTCP listener, two inherited-fd wolfSSL DTLS workers, two independent LINK/LiveID sessions, concurrent unique application echoes with no cross-session routing.
udp_like_status.two_session_load_gate: Authoritative GitHub Actions mux-load-100m run 32918572671 SUCCESS at a 100 Mbit/s shared link, two simultaneous 20 Mbit/s inner streams, RTT 20/100 ms, setup loss 0 and measurement random loss 20%. Fixed 20:20 delivered 100% at both RTTs versus off about 80%; p99 increased by 9.617/10.415ms and exact fixed plaintext expansion was 2.1622x/2.1597x.
udp_like_status.capacity_diagnostic: Run 32920381126 at commit 621653e30f8bd7e9d9d26bce598077d8391043ad is non-authoritative as an aggregate because fixed artifact names contained ':'. Its completed network logs nevertheless show fixed20:20 p99 at aggregate 60M/80M of 305.948/915.466ms for RTT20 and 181.819/994.520ms for RTT100, with balanced per-session delivery. Corrected workflow begins at 71501859c6fc1aa1a6d1a6b048af5aebcf984732. Forty Mbit/s remains the conservative qualified aggregate-inner point until a clean corrected result proves otherwise.
udp_like_status.lifecycle: Client sends DTLS-protected WBD PING after 15s idle, handles PONG/CLOSE, and on normal stop flushes FEC then best-effort CLOSE_NORMAL. Shared link server refreshes active leases on data/control/service traffic, echoes lifecycle control via the existing state machine, and reclaims idle LiveID slots after a default 90s lease.
udp_like_status.memory_policy: Performance first: retain bounded independent state per LiveID and never gate new inner datagrams on pending repair depth merely to save memory.
udp_like_status.capacity_policy: Active release qualification uses a 100 Mbit/s weak shared link or lower. Forty Mbit/s aggregate inner is the current conservative qualified operating point. Sixty and eighty Mbit/s are not qualified because the coarse diagnostic shows persistent tail-latency collapse; a single midpoint around 50 Mbit/s may be characterized without protocol retuning if extra capacity is needed.

product_policy.link_setup: Reality-like TLS front is connection setup only. Recognized same-entry TLS authenticates the shared username/password and issues a fresh one-time ticket; FakeTCP/DTLS then performs ticket bind and immutable LINK_INIT/LINK_ACCEPT. Sustained VPN payload never uses the front TCP stream.
product_policy.fec: Association setup admits off or fixed systematic 20:20 tail-RS. No runtime FEC config epoch; adaptive/intermediate profiles remain research until separately qualified.
product_policy.accounts: One configured shared username/password may authenticate multiple simultaneous devices. Every login gets a distinct random ticket/LiveID; live routing and FEC state are keyed by LiveID/peer, never username.
product_policy.recovery: FakeTCP product default is legacy shadow recovery. sack-rack remains opt-in experimental/diagnostic and is not a release default.
product_policy.certificate_policy: Personal client may explicitly disable certificate-chain and hostname verification for both front TLS and DTLS while encryption remains enabled and logs disclose the verification mode.
product_policy.routing: OpenWrt final capture is TPROXY plus policy routing and underlay escape; Windows final capture is TUN/Wintun-class with endpoint escape. Linux TUN remains a regression harness.
product_policy.release_gate: After protocol/unit/pcap/100M weak-link and capacity gates are green, freeze protocol, then require one clean end-to-end VPN success on OpenWrt TPROXY and one on Windows TUN including real DNS/TCP/UDP application traffic, underlay escape and cleanup/restoration.
